name: Bandboss' Upcoming Events Manager
author: ronniebandboss

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/bandboss-upcoming-events-manager directory or downlaod directly from plugin library.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Upcoming Events → Settings to configure when needed.
  4. Use the shortcode [bandboss_upcoming_events] to display upcoming events.
    Attributes:

    • show_all=”true” — show all events from today onwards.
      [bandboss_upcoming_events show_all=”true”]

sections.description:
Description Clean, lightweight “Upcoming Events” for WordPress. Add events with date/time/venue/tickets, display a selection or everything from today

Upcoming events Plugin Build by Bandboss Webdesign!

BandBoss Upcoming Events is built for musicians and organizers who want to put their shows in the spotlight without spending hours behind the computer.
Add your shows in the WordPress dashboard and have them automatically appear on your site with a single, simple shortcode.

No unnecessary styling, just a super-fast, clean presentation of your event schedule.

Bandboss website | Plugin page | Instagram | Facebook | TikTok

Why this plugin?
🎸 Built for music & events
💨 Fast and lightweight
👍 Super easy to manage
👨‍💻 No code, only the a shortcode

✨ Feature highlights

The plugin automatically shows country flags based on the provided country code. You can choose to display a fixed number of events or all events up to a specific end date. For each event, simply add the time, ticket price, a link to the Facebook event, and a ticket-sale link. The frontend output is intentionally clean and lightweight, so no page builder is required.

✨ Upgrade to Pro for full control:

With Pro, you can style each element individually, like:

✅ Date Day
✅ Date Number
✅ Date Month
✅ Date Year
✅ Venue
✅ Start time
✅ Entrance fee
✅ City
✅ Ticket button
✅ Fonts
✅ Font sizes
✅ Font colors
✅ Colors

✨ You also get two handy toggles with pro:

✅ Sold Out to clearly mark sold-out events
✅ Event Highlight to give specific events extra visual emphasis.

🎤 🎼 🥁 🎸**Ready for your next show?**🎻 🎵 🎶🎛️

Never let your audience miss a performance.
Download Bandbox’s Upcoming Events and put your gigs in the spotlight.
